headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Fall to Nine-Month Low on Weak Rival Oils
summary: Benchmark palm oil futures on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange fell 1.83% to 4,140 ringgit ($1,005.59) per metric ton, extending losses to a fifth consecutive session.
why: Malaysia is the world's second-largest producer and exporter of palm oil.

impacts.name: Palm Oil
impacts.why: Malaysian palm oil futures declined 1.83% to hit their lowest level in nearly nine months.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Palm oil futures declined due to spillover weakness in competing vegetable oil markets in Dalian and Chicago.
